```{r}
#Pull data:

#NCSS data:

    #pedon, taxonomic name and series name: 
    ncss_pedon <- read.csv("../data/Pedon_SCP_MLRA.csv") #siteobsiiref is pedon id
    
    #horizon name, seq, top depth, bottom depth, some texture:
    ncss_phorizon <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phorizon.csv") #peiidref is pedon id (multiples per pedon)
  
    #color per horizon, hue value, chroma:
    ncss_color <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phcolor.csv") #phiidref is pedon id
    
    #mottles present per hz, HVC and percentage:
    ncss_mottles <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phmottles.csv") #phiidref is pedon id
    
    #lab data: CEC
    ncss_labdata <- read.csv("../data/ncss_labdata.csv") #ncsslabdataiidref is pedon id , seq is hz 
    
    #ped_taxa:
    ncss_ped_taxa <- read.csv("../data/petaxhistory.csv")
    
    #ncss pedon lab data:
    ncss_pedonlabdata <- read.csv("../data/ncss_pedonlabdata.csv")
    #ncss layer lab data:
    ncss_layerlabdata <- read.csv("../data/ncss_layerlabdata.csv") 
    
    #pedon horizon sample:
    ncss_phsample <- read.csv("../data/ncss_phsample.csv") #peiidref is pedon id, seq is hz, sampleid is sample id
    
    # str(ncss_pedon)
    # str(ncss_phorizon)
    str(ncss_color)
    # str(ncss_mottles)
    # str(ncss_labdata)
    # str(ncss_pedonlabdata)
    str(ncss_phsample)
```

```{r}

#try to merge labdata and phorizon based on unique patterns per pedon:

# keep only your pedons
my_pedons <- unique(ncss_pedon$peiid)

# bridge lab layers -> peiidref (pedon)
pedlab_unique <- ncss_layerlabdata %>%
  mutate(
    filled_n = rowSums(!is.na(across(everything())))
  ) %>%
  group_by(ncsslayerlabdataiid, labsampnum) %>%
  arrange(desc(filled_n), desc(recwlupdated)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

lab_with_ped <- ncss_labdata %>%
  left_join(
    pedlab_unique %>% select(ncsspedonlabdataiid, peiidref),
    by = c("ncsspedonlabdataiidref" = "ncsspedonlabdataiid")
  ) %>%
  filter(peiidref %in% my_pedons)
clean_hz <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x) | x == "", NA_character_, x)
  # remove spaces, keep letters+digits
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "", x)
  x
}


# clean the sample number format (this matters a lot)
lab_key <- lab_with_ped %>%
  mutate(labsampnum = str_trim(labsampnum)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(labsampnum), labsampnum != "") %>%
  distinct(labsampnum, .keep_all = TRUE)   # labsampnum should be unique in lab layer table

phs_key <- ncss_phsample %>%
  mutate(labsampnum = str_trim(labsampnum)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(labsampnum), labsampnum != "")
phs_key %>%
  count(labsampnum) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), n_dupes = sum(n > 1), max_dupe = max(n))
phs_best <- phs_key %>%
  mutate(filled = rowSums(!is.na(across(everything())))) %>%
  group_by(labsampnum) %>%
  arrange(desc(filled), desc(recwlupdated)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()
phs_lab <- phs_best %>%
  left_join(
    lab_key %>%
      select(
        labsampnum, peiidref, ncsslayerlabdataiid, layerseqnum,
        hzdept, hzdepb, hzname, hznameoriginal
      ),
    by = "labsampnum"
  )
phorizon_joined <- ncss_phorizon %>%
  left_join(
    phs_lab %>% select(phiidref, labsampnum, peiidref, ncsslayerlabdataiid, layerdepthtop, layerdepthbottom),
    by = c("phiid" = "phiidref")
  )
phorizon_joined2 <- phorizon_joined %>%
  left_join(
    ncss_labdata,
    by = "ncsslayerlabdataiid"
  )
cat("phsample rows:", nrow(ncss_phsample), "\n")
cat("phs_best rows:", nrow(phs_best), "\n")
cat("Rows in phs_lab with peiidref:", sum(!is.na(phs_lab$peiidref)), "\n")
cat("phorizon rows:", nrow(ncss_phorizon), "\n")
cat("phorizon rows with labsampnum:", sum(!is.na(phorizon_joined$labsampnum)), "\n")

# check depth consistency between phsample and phorizon (optional but super useful)
phorizon_joined %>%
  filter(!is.na(labsampnum)) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_top_match = mean(hzdept == layerdepthtop, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    pct_bot_match = mean(hzdepb == layerdepthbottom, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    median_top_diff = median(abs(hzdept - layerdepthtop), na.rm = TRUE),
    median_bot_diff = median(abs(hzdepb - layerdepthbottom), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

```
```{r}
coastal_peiid <- unique(ncss_pedon$peiid)
length(coastal_peiid)
phorizon_cp <- phorizon_joined2 %>%
  filter(peiidref.x %in% coastal_peiid)

cat("Rows (all):", nrow(phorizon_joined2), "\n")
cat("Rows (coastal plain):", nrow(phorizon_cp), "\n")
cat("Unique pedons (coastal plain):", n_distinct(phorizon_cp$peiidref), "\n")
ped_cp <- ncss_pedon %>%
  transmute(
    peiidref = peiid,
    upedonid,
    taxonname,
    taxclname,
    labsourceid,
    pedlabsampnum,
    pedonhydricrating,
    grpiidref
  )

phorizon_cp <- phorizon_cp %>%
  #rename peiidref.x to peiidref for clarity
  rename(peiidref = peiidref.x) %>%
  left_join(ped_cp, by = "peiidref") %>%
  #drop empty columns if all NA
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))
```

```{r}

taxa_best <- ncss_ped_taxa %>%
  mutate(
    classtype = str_trim(classtype),
    taxorder = na_if(str_trim(taxorder), ""),
    taxsuborder = na_if(str_trim(taxsuborder), ""),
    taxgrtgroup = na_if(str_trim(taxgrtgroup), ""),
    taxsubgrp = na_if(str_trim(taxsubgrp), ""),
    taxpartsize = na_if(str_trim(taxpartsize), ""),
    taxclname = na_if(str_trim(taxclname), ""),
    taxonname = na_if(str_trim(taxonname), "")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    filled = rowSums(!is.na(across(c(taxonname, taxclname, taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize))))
  ) %>%
  group_by(peiidref) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(classtype == "Sampled as"),  # prefer sampled-as
    desc(filled),                    # prefer most complete
    desc(recwlupdated)               # prefer most recently updated (string, but still works decently)
  ) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    peiidref,
    classtype, classdate,
    taxonname, taxclname,
    taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp,
    taxpartsize, taxpartsizemod,
    taxtempcl, taxmoistscl, taxtempregime,
    soiltaxedition
  )
taxa_best_cp <- taxa_best %>%
  filter(peiidref %in% coastal_peiid)
phorizon_cp_taxa <- phorizon_cp %>%
  left_join(taxa_best_cp, by = "peiidref")

cat("Rows:", nrow(phorizon_cp_taxa), "\n")
cat("Unique pedons:", dplyr::n_distinct(phorizon_cp_taxa$peiidref), "\n")
cat("Pedons with taxonomy:", sum(!is.na(phorizon_cp_taxa$taxorder)), "\n")
ncss_ped_taxa %>%
  count(peiidref) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pedons = n(),
    pct_multi = mean(n > 1) * 100,
    max_rows = max(n)
  )
```

```{r}
#umap of all properties in phorizon_cp_taxa_color
dat <- phorizon_cp_taxa_color %>%
  mutate(
    hz_thk = hzdepb.x - hzdept.x,
    hz_master = str_to_upper(str_extract(toupper(hzname.x), "^[A-Z]+")),  # crude master
    hz_master = ifelse(is.na(hz_master) | hz_master == "", "UNK", hz_master),
    taxorder  = ifelse(is.na(taxorder)  | str_trim(taxorder)  == "", "UNKNOWN", taxorder),
    taxsubgrp = ifelse(is.na(taxsubgrp) | str_trim(taxsubgrp) == "", "UNKNOWN", taxsubgrp),
    hue = ifelse(is.na(hue_moist) | str_trim(hue_moist) == "", "UNK", hue_moist)
  )

# ---- choose numeric features that exist ----
num_candidates <- c(
  "hzdept","hzdepb","hz_thk",
  "value_moist_int","chroma_moist_int",
  "sandtotmeasured","silttotmeasured","claytotmeasured",
  "ph1to1h2o","cec7","ecec","carbonorganicpctmeasured",
  "dbovendry","dbthirdbar","wfifteenbarmeasured"
)

num_vars <- intersect(num_candidates, names(dat))

num_block <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(num_vars)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_))) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x))) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))  # scale numeric

# ---- categorical block (keep it small so it doesn’t explode) ----
cat_block <- dat %>%
  transmute(
    hz_master = factor(hz_master),
    taxorder  = factor(taxorder),
    # taxsubgrp can have lots of levels; keep it if you want, or comment out:
    taxsubgrp = factor(taxsubgrp),
    hue = factor(hue)
  )

# one-hot using model.matrix (fast)
X_cat <- model.matrix(~ hz_master + taxorder + taxsubgrp + hue - 1, data = cat_block)

# combine
X <- cbind(as.matrix(num_block), X_cat)

set.seed(1)
u <- umap::umap(X)

umap_res <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    UMAP1 = u$layout[,1],
    UMAP2 = u$layout[,2]
  )

# ---- plot: color by taxorder (or clay, or hue) ----
ggplot(umap_res, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = taxonname.x )) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(color = "Taxorder")
```
